# Axom Hub

> AI and business technology agency in Guwahati, Assam serving Indian SMBs with AI agents, WhatsApp automation, custom software, websites, and AI integrations.

Axom Hub is an AI and business technology agency based in Guwahati, Assam, serving small and medium businesses across India—including coaching institutes, retailers and showrooms, clinics, distributors, real estate teams, and other growing SMBs. Axom Hub designs practical AI agents, WhatsApp automation, business automation, custom software, websites and applications, and AI integrations without enterprise complexity. Note that the examples on the Work page are interactive concept demos and product prototypes rather than client deployments.

## Services

- [AI Agents](https://REPLACE-WITH-MY-DOMAIN/services/ai-agents): Trained digital assistants that reply to customer enquiries on your website and WhatsApp, qualify leads, and book appointments around the clock.
- [WhatsApp Automation](https://REPLACE-WITH-MY-DOMAIN/services/automation): Structured WhatsApp Business workflows for instant brochure sharing, admission or showroom follow-ups, booking confirmations, and fee or dispatch reminders.
- [Business Automation](https://REPLACE-WITH-MY-DOMAIN/services/automation): Connect your enquiry forms, Google Sheets, calendars, billing tools, and internal team alerts so routine updates happen automatically.
- [Custom Software](https://REPLACE-WITH-MY-DOMAIN/services/software): Focused internal portals, operations dashboards, and management systems built around the exact rules of your coaching centre, clinic, showroom, or distribution desk.
- [Websites & Applications](https://REPLACE-WITH-MY-DOMAIN/services/software): Fast, mobile-ready business websites, customer booking portals, and lightweight web or mobile applications built to convert local and regional traffic.
- [AI Integrations](https://REPLACE-WITH-MY-DOMAIN/services/software): Connect AI capabilities directly into your existing spreadsheets, websites, ERPs, billing tools, and support portals without replacing systems that already work.

- [Coaching Institutes](https://REPLACE-WITH-MY-DOMAIN/industries): Admissions AI agent on WhatsApp & web, automated demo-class scheduling, and a clean batch & fee portal.
